verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an explicit 'Open Source' edition that runs on your own infrastructure and gives you full ownership of the stack, and probes confirm the pip/npm packages (mem0ai) install and import cleanly, evidencing that the code is actually distributed and runnable, not just marketing language. However, the evidence pack never names a specific open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache-2.0) or links to a public source repository, so an AI-native user cannot confirm from this evidence exactly what license governs reading/redistributing the source. Missing for 10: explicit license name/citation, direct link to the public source repository, confirmation of license file contents.
